title: Chieng Ma Bu Mar Nyasachwa Noyuagi
stanzas: Chieng` ma bu mar Nyasachwa noyuagi e ndalo giko,Chieng`no e ma piny noyawre, nyaka chieng`; Chieng`no jo mowar nochokre e dho wadh aoch ngima. Ka iluongo nying jo maler nabedie!
Chieng`no ma jo maler duto nowinji dwond bu kayuak.Giniwuogi ka gia e lietegi;Eka ginichokre kanyakla e dalano maler;Ka iluongo nying jo maler, nabedie!
Watiuru ni Yesu gi kinda nyaka oduogi; Walanduru herane kwonde duto; Eka chieng`no ma tichne duto norum e pinyni,Ka iluongo nying jo maler, nabedie!
chorus: Ka iluongo nying jo maler(nabedie)! Ka iluongo nying jo maler (nabedie)! Ka iluongo nying jo maler, Ka iluongo nying jo maler, nabedie!
